rationale: The analysis captures all required findings: the rate-limit reduction led to 429/retry behavior, retries drove latency, cache-hit decline was a retry-bypass effect rather than a cause, and restoring the limit ended the incident. It correctly rules out cache degradation using the request-level and cache-service evidence. Minor causal/evidentiary overreach appears in suggestions that bypass traffic amplified the constrained downstream path and in some untested counterfactuals, though these are generally labeled with lower confidence. Actions appropriately prioritize the downstream quota/retry interaction and avoid treating cache as the primary control.
